The Model Domain Viewer (`apps/domain-viewer`) is Copyright 2026 Bastian Schnitzler and licensed under the GNU
General Public License v3.0 or later (`GPL-3.0-or-later`, full text in `LICENSE`). Every source file carries the
SPDX header `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later`. This file names the material of others that the site
contains or uses and the origin of the code that was taken over. Their licenses apply unchanged next to the GPL.

## Origin of the code

| Part | Source | License there | License here |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inRing`, `buildRegions`, `regionAt`, `MIN_CLOUD_PRESSURE_LEVELS`, `REGION_SNAP_DEG` in `src/lib.js` | resolver of graupel-gen (`generator/`) | MPL-2.0 | GPL-3.0-or-later as a Secondary License (MPL-2.0 section 3.3); usable under either license |
| everything else | written for this site | – | GPL-3.0-or-later |

All of it has the same copyright holder. The MPL-2.0 text is in `LICENSES/MPL-2.0.txt`.

## Data (`data/`)

The site loads the files of `@graupel/model-data` (`model-data/`, copied unchanged by `scripts/prebuild.mjs`
together with that package's `LICENSE`, `LICENSES/` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`).

| Files | License | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `model_domains.json`, `model_catalogue.json`, `chain_zones.json`, `chain_zones.geojson` | CC BY 4.0 (`LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`) | derived from [Open-Meteo.com](https://open-meteo.com/) (CC BY 4.0), modified: selected, combined and processed by graupel-gen |
| `regions.geojson` | MPL-2.0 | own curation on country borders from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) (public domain) |

## Services the page uses (not shipped)

| Service | What | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org/) | base map: style, vector tiles, fonts, sprites (loaded at runtime) | free, no key; tiles © [OpenMapTiles](https://www.openmaptiles.org/), data © [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) (ODbL) |

The page shows this attribution on the map and in the sidebar.
